source_snapshot.items: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and UPHY1 from first PG548
source_snapshot.procedure: Logs into BMC, reads mux0x71 on i2c-tools bus5, writes0x04 to enable mux port2, and refers to PID1114953 for expected downstream devices.
source_snapshot.criteria: Contains only generic after-test collection and unexpected-log language; it does not state the expected mux readback, downstream address/reply or restoration value.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; invents required physical probing/soldering/photos even though the source supplies a BMC functional I2C read/write procedure and does not request continuity probing.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CHANGED; continues the unsupported physical-probe interpretation and treats photos as core acceptance, while correctly noting the mux write changes state.
source_snapshot.items_direct_xlsx: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and UPHY1 from first PG548
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: "【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). Log into the BMC and run the following command and ensure you get a reply. Refer to PID : 1114953 for other devices expected on the bus. i2cget -f -y 5 0x71 #Read MUX ports enabled i2ctransfer -y 5 w1@0x71 0x04 #Enable MUX Port 2""
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test."
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: NO | -- not runnable by agent: testing the physical I2C connection/link between the named components (BMC I2C-6 and UPHY1 from first PG548) is a hardware-integrity check that requires probing/soldering the actual I2C traces and collecting photos per the criteria; the agent cannot touch the hardware or take photos over SSH.

test_case.test_name: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and UPHY1 from first PG548 — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify the first PG548 path from the BMC I2C-6 controller through mux0x71 port2 to UPHY1 by performing the approved BMC-side mux read/select and confirming the PID1114953-defined downstream replies, without inferring physical continuity from an unrelated bus.
required_package: PID1114953 first-PG548 topology and expected UPHY1/downstream device-address/reply matrix
BMC controller identity proving logical I2C-6 maps to Linux/i2c-tools bus5
Mux0x71 register definition, port2 select value0x04, allowed combined-channel bits and expected pre/post readback
Current mux owner/driver and exclusive access window for forced `i2cget -f` and raw `i2ctransfer`
Exact downstream read transaction(s), success response and timeout/NACK/error criteria
Original mux value, restoration command, independent BMC recovery path and post-restore management checks
test_case.test_command: Map logical BMC I2C-6 to i2c-tools bus5 and first-PG548 mux0x71; record current mux register; confirm port2 bit/value and downstream expected addresses from PID1114953; write0x04 only with approval; query the exact UPHY1/downstream devices; correlate replies and absence of bus errors; restore the recorded mux value and verify other channels/management health.
test_case.expected_result: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test."

Confirm that physical probing/photos are not required unless separately approved.
safety_gate: Run only on BMC/platform-management scope with authoritative bus/address map and independent management recovery
Confirm no kernel driver, daemon or concurrent test owns mux0x71 before using force/raw access
Capture the original mux byte and bus health; do not assume0x04 may replace other required channel bits
Perform one approved select and bounded downstream read; abort on NACK, arbitration loss, timeout, stuck bus or management degradation
Restore the exact recorded state and verify all PID-listed devices and BMC management services
expected_evidence: PID1114953 excerpt and BMC I2C-6-to-bus5-to-mux0x71-port2-to-UPHY1 topology
BMC identity, i2c-tools version, bus ownership/concurrency and management-health baseline
Original mux byte plus exact approved read/select transcript and0x04 readback interpretation
PID-defined downstream UPHY1/device transaction outputs, exit codes, timestamps and expected-versus-observed matrix
BMC kernel/daemon/bus-error logs and no unrelated channel/service impact
Exact mux restoration/readback, device/service health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Per Wistron policy, I2C is BMC/platform-management scope. Require controller, bus, mux address, OOB/recovery and expected response; never infer the path from a generic Linux bus number alone.

source_conflict.reason: The Criteria field provides no functional expected result, while the Procedure says BMC I2C-6 but commands use bus5 without mapping. DeepSeek/GPT V2 add physical probing, soldering and mandatory photos as core coverage although none is specified by the source Procedure.
